response.sql:
WITH observatory_shares AS (
  SELECT observstation,
         COUNT(*) AS telescope_count,
         CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
), above_average AS (
  SELECT telescope_count, share,
         AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
  FROM observatory_shares
  WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM observatory_shares)
)
SELECT SUM(telescope_count) AS total_telescopes,
       AVG(share) AS average_share,
       AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM above_average;

assumptions.assumption: Each observatory represented by at least one row in telescopes is included; observatories with zero telescopes are not represented in the available schema relationship for this count.
